source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The two Graph checks added in 3993 call Assert.ok with one argument and Assert.deepEqual with two arguments, so neither supplies an assertion message. Comments describing the scenario do not replace those missing arguments. The accepted Graph checks still omit messages. A scoped improvement is to state the expected disabled-provider and enabled-scope outcomes in nonempty messages containing should. For example, "Microsoft Graph metadata should be unavailable when Graph support is disabled." and "Enabled Microsoft Graph metadata should contain the expected issuer and scopes." The positive test compares a structure; the negative checks an absent result. This finding concerns missing messages, not a defect based only on the word should, and it is not a claim that the tests ran.
title: Graph provider checks need explicit expected-behavior assertion messages
